# Rootwills (Rootwills Ltd)
> Rootwills Ltd is a UK commercial food services and hospitality wholesale supplier providing 5,480+ chef-graded lines across Fresh Farm Produce, Prime British Butchery, Artisan Dairy, Coastal Seafood, Bakery, and Ambient Larder with 6-day pre-dawn refrigerated deliveries (04:00–07:30 AM) across Birmingham, the West Midlands, Manchester, and Greater London.

## Main Sections
- [Home](https://www.rootwills.co.uk/): Commercial foodservice overview, British grower provenance, and hospitality supply pillars.
- [Wholesale Product Catalog](https://www.rootwills.co.uk/products): 5,480+ multi-temperature wholesale catering lines across produce, meat, poultry, dairy, seafood, bakery, frozen, and ambient dry store.
- [Hospitality Solutions & Services](https://www.rootwills.co.uk/services): Tailored B2B foodservice supply for independent restaurants, hotel groups, contract caterers, gastro pubs, and institutional kitchens in Birmingham and the UK.
- [Quality Standards & Cold Chain Logistics](https://www.rootwills.co.uk/approach): 02:00 AM daily depot intake grading, BRCGS Grade AA storage standards, Red Tractor farm assurance, HACCP compliance, and dual-evaporator refrigerated fleet telemetry.
- [About Rootwills](https://www.rootwills.co.uk/about): Direct British farm alliances across Worcestershire, Warwickshire, Kent, Evesham, and Lincolnshire.
- [Wholesale Trade Desk & Contact](https://www.rootwills.co.uk/contact): Open a commercial trade account, book a trial kitchen delivery, or request bespoke volume contract pricing.
- [Wholesale Supply Terms](https://www.rootwills.co.uk/terms): B2B commercial supply terms, 23:00 PM evening cut-offs, and pre-dawn fulfilment SLAs.
- [Privacy & UK GDPR Policy](https://www.rootwills.co.uk/privacy): Data protection and privacy standards for commercial trade partners.

## Key Facts & Operational Metrics
- **Legal Entity:** Rootwills Ltd (UK Companies House Registration: 17398744)
- **Primary Distribution Hub:** The Hub, Nobel Way, Birmingham, West Midlands, B6 7EU, United Kingdom
- **Service Regions:** Birmingham, West Midlands, Coventry, Manchester, and Greater London
- **Catalog Size:** 5,480+ multi-temperature foodservice SKUs (Chilled 1–4°C, Butchery 0–2°C, Frozen -18°C, Ambient)
- **Delivery Window:** Monday to Saturday, 04:00 AM – 07:30 AM pre-dawn kitchen cold-room drop
- **Order Cut-Off:** 23:00 PM for next-morning pre-dawn delivery
- **Accreditations:** BRCGS Storage & Distribution, Red Tractor Farm Assured, HACCP Food Safety System, Lion Quality Code of Practice
